title: Xi Jinping Is Coming to the US. Why Is He Skipping the UNGA?
gist: Xi Jinping's Sept 23-25, 2026 US trip included a Trump tarmac welcome, White House summit, state dinner, tea and a National Archives visit, but Xi skipped the UN General Assembly; he has attended UNGA in person only once, in 2015. The piece asks why.

insights.claim: Xi Jinping has attended a UN General Assembly session in person only once, in September 2015, and skipped UNGA again despite being in the US in September 2026.
insights.speaker: Shannon Tiezzi
insights.so_what: Signals Beijing prioritizes leader-level bilateral deals with Washington over multilateral stagecraft.

insights.claim: The White House itinerary had Trump personally receiving Xi at Andrews Air Force Base on September 23, a formal welcome, summit and state dinner on September 24, and tea plus a National Archives visit on September 25.
insights.speaker: Shannon Tiezzi
insights.so_what: Elaborate protocol indicates high US investment in summit optics.
insights.locator: According to the White House’s itinerary

insights.claim: Trump and Melania Trump planned to show Xi and his wife records significant to the US-China relationship at the National Archives, emphasizing historic ties.
insights.speaker: Shannon Tiezzi
insights.so_what: Symbolism suggests a deliberate effort to frame the relationship as partnership.
insights.quote: where they will view a variety of important records and documents significant to the American and Chinese relationship throughout history
insights.locator: According to the White House’s itinerary
